hook: Sab Ek Saath Koodein Toh Earth Hilegi?
teaser: Myth ya fact? Aakhir tak dekho

points.title: Myth: Earth hil jayegi
points.text: Log sochte hain 8 arab log ek saath koode toh Earth apni jagah se khisak jayegi.

points.title: Fact: Hum bahut halke
points.text: Saare insaan milke bhi Earth se 10 lakh crore guna se zyada halke hain.

points.title: Kitna khisakegi Earth?
points.text: Ek atom ki chaudai se bhi bahut kam. Koi mehsoos tak nahi karega.

points.title: Landing pe kya hoga?
points.text: Hum neeche girenge aur Earth wapas apni jagah. Orbit pe koi asar nahi.

takeaway: Earth hilegi, par ek atom jitna bhi nahi!
cta: Follow karo, kal naya What If
